applicationInfo.name: <change-name> threat model
applicationInfo.description: Replace with this change's scope (1-2 paragraphs): what it adds/changes and the trust boundaries it touches. The threat-model subagent authors this per .claude/agents/threat-model.md; this file is the canonical Threat Composer v1 shape, not a fill-in form.

architecture.description: Narrative of the components this change touches (Lambdas, IAM roles, KMS keys, ECR/S3/DynamoDB, EventBridge). The base64 `image` field is populated in-flow by `tc_render.py` (`mise run tm-render`) per ADR-0013 — it embeds the first non-DFD mermaid diagram from design.md as a PNG; rendering fails open to an empty field when `mmdc` is unavailable, with the mermaid source in design.md remaining canonical.

dataflow.description:
Narrative of the new/changed data flows, followed by the trust-boundary DFD. The SAME mermaid source is mirrored into design.md's `## Threats` section (keep the two identical). Untrusted regions are styled distinctly; every trust-boundary crossing should map to at least one threat below. Example shape:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph untrusted [Untrusted producer-asserted input]
        P[producer field]
    end
    G[trust-boundary gate]
    S[(trusted store)]
    P -->|producer influenced| G
    G -->|validated| S
    style untrusted fill:#fdd,stroke:#c00
    style G fill:#ffd,stroke:#aa0
```

mitigations.content: EXAMPLE — the trust-boundary gate re-validates the producer-asserted field before it is persisted. Set status to mitigationResolved ONLY if this control already exists in the codebase; leave it mitigationIdentified when this change's tasks will build it.

threats.threatImpact: the field is persisted or rendered without validation
threats.statement: EXAMPLE — an external actor who can push producer-asserted content can supply a crafted field value, which leads to the field being persisted or rendered without validation, negatively impacting integrity of <asset>.
